notes.title: Clayverse Update – New Ship Repairs & Upgrades!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="TuobNyXn9mc;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! It’s been a little while since our last update, but we’ve been busy working on some cool new stuff for the game, and we’re excited to share it with you.

When you first start your journey, the spaceship is going to be in rough conditions. You’ll now need to use some of the clay you collect during your missions to repair and upgrade the ship. This will open up many new gameplay possibilities, like:

Crafting: Craft powerful gear to help you survive tougher situations.

Customisation: Personalise your appearance.

Talent Trees: Unlock new skills and abilities as you level up.

New Locations: As you progress, you’ll get to explore farther planets.

And this is just the start – we’ve got a lot more ideas in the works to keep expanding and improving this feature going forward. 

Check out the sneak peek video below! (Heads up, it's still a work in progress, so the transition is a little rough right now, but we’re on it.)
